content: Nowan garkaz kaziw kazil
Sem, Am, a Zapeth Nowan garkaz kazil, thanamun kaziw kazil woer thoerpumay kalanu itha kedha.
Zapethan garkaz kazil itha kedha, Gomer, Magog, Maday, Zaban, Thubal, Mesek, a Tiras. Itha thana muruygal, thana buwayl mura thanamun geth buway muruygaw nelaygal.
Gomeran kaziw kazil itha thabi lagaw mabaygal, Askenaz, Ripath, a Togarma.
Zabanan kaziw kazil itha thabi lagaw mabaygal, Elisa, Soepeyn, Sayprus, Rodes.
Wa, thana mura woerngu buwadhaw mabaygal, kawaw mabaygal. Thana matha kedha lak Zapethoengu pawpa nungu kaziw kazil kasa kay kedha thanamuniya thanamun geth yangukudul.
Aman garkaz kazil itha kedha, Kus Aykupithu Lebiya, a Kanan; thana thanamun nelay mabaygaw kuyku mabaygal.
Kusenoengu pawpa kaziw kazil nanga, Sebalgal, Abilalgal, Sabthalgal, Ramalgal, a Sebtekalgal. Rawalngu pawpa kaziw kazil nanga Sebalgal a Dedoenigal.
Kusan mabaygal
Kusan wara garkaz kazi nel Nimrod, nuy mina kay magawal mabayg.

Nuy aypu lumepu nanga matha moeygoepa. Minguz kedha Awgadhan nuyn ibupuydhaypu, kedha zoenguz mabaygal kedha umamoeypu thanamun igalgoepa, ‘Awgadhaw woenab ngibiya kalmel a nuydh bangal ngibepa koey moegaw poeybane, a ngi bangal koey aypu lumaylayg ngoedhe kedha Nimrod midh.’
Koeykoeyne na nuydh kuyk aymoedhin nungu yadaymayl itha thabi loegal Babilon Erek a Arkad itha thabi loegal Babilonaw doegamunu.
Nuy seyzi meparu Asiriyapa a koey goegath moeydhadhin kayb kedha thoeraypa Nineba, a wara Rewobet Oer, a wara Kala.
Wara koey goegath nuydh moeydhadhin Resan na sey dhadhal Ninebaya a Kalaya.

Aykupithungu pawpa kaziw kazil nanga Lidiyalgal, Anamalgal, Liyabalgal, a Napathoelaylgal Patharusalgal, Kasluwalgal, a thana setha Koerithalgal, wagel mura Pilistaw mabaygal Thanamun kuyk Koerithangu.
Kananan ukasar garkaz kazi
Kananan garkaz kazi ukasar, Sidon kuykuyg a Eth kuthayg, palamulngu ukasar buway tharimoedhin kedha, Sidonan buway a Ethan buway.
Nuy Kanana wara Zebusaythalgaw muruyg, a Amaraythalgaw muruyg, Gergoesaytalgaw muruyg, a
Ebaytalgaw muruyg, a Arkaythalgaw muruyg, a Sinaylgaw muruyg, a

wara Abadaytalgaw muruyg, a Zemaraytalgaw muruyg a Amathaythalgaw muruyg. Wa, nuy Kanana mura thanamun muruyg a thana nungu kaziw kazil mura woeyamoeydhin kurusipa lag Sidon a Gerar zaya doegamoenu Gazapa amadhan a sageraw doegamoenu nanga Sodom, Gomora, Adhama a Zebowim, Lasapa amadhan.

Wa, itha mura Aman kaziw kazil Kusalgaw buwayngu kuykaymay, kurusipa Amathaythalgal. Thana mura thanamun geth wara buwaya a wara koey goegathiya nithamoedhin a thana mura thanamun geth yangukudulgal yaynanob.
Zapethan kuykuyg Sem nuy mura Eboerulgaw muruyg,
Seman garkaz kazil itha kedha, Elam, Asur, Apasadh, Lud, a Aram. Itha thana muruygal, thana buwayl mura thanamun geth buway muruygaw nelaygal.
Araman kaziw kazil itha thabi goegathiya nipa Uz, Ul, Getha, a Mesek.
Apasadhan garkaz kazi Sela, a Selan garkaz kazi Iber.

Nungu Eberan garkaz kazi ukasar garkaz. Wara nel Peleg a wara nel Zoktan. Pelegan kazimay thonar nanga Awgadhan mura nubi apaw goewaw mabaygal siga gudal wanaydhin mura yaynanob lagiya, nubi po gubaw gizuya.
Zoktanan kaziw kazil nanga thana itha thabi buwayl aymoeydhin, Almodadalgal, Selepalgal, Azarmabethalgal, Zaralgal,
Adoramalgal, Uzalgal, Diklalalgal,
Obalgal, Abimoelgal, Sebalgal,
Opiralgal, Abilalgal, a Zobabalgal. Wa, itha mura Zoktanoengu pawpa kupar palaydhin.
Thanamun koeygarsar goegathal woeraw doegam padaw dhadha sakariya Mesangu kurusipa Sepapa.
Wa, nuy Zoktan wara Seman buway mabayg a itha mura yaynanob nanga Zoktanan buway thana matha kedha Seman buway, thana urapun, kasa kay kedha thana thanamun geth yangukudulgal.

Itha mura thabi buwayl kazipay ngapa Semoelngu, a nungu ukasar tukuyap, Am a Zapeth thanamulngu thana mura Nowalngu, thanamun koey muruyg. Thoerpumay woerngu kalanu nanga mura nubi po gubaw gizu buwayl nungungu mura, Nowalngu.
